decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The noise generated from the air conditioning plant should be inaudible when assessed from the nearest noise receptor and the level of noise emitted form the proposed air conditioning plant shall not be less than 10dB(A) below the existing background noise levels (LAeq), when measured from the nearest noise sensitive receptor over any 24 hour period.

Condition : 4 - Before the installation of the generator in the car park a scheme indicating protective measures for the nearby Tree Preservation Order trees shall be submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The approved screening surrounding the air conditioning plant on the roof of the building should be painted black.
description: Installation of air conditioning plant and associated screening to the roof and the installation of a generator to the car park
